---
title: "Classical Themes (rough)"
description: "The original 9,824 themes (midi2abc from the EDM MIDI), unreliable, kept for reference. Not linked from the menus."
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<style>
#ct-root { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
#ct-root .ct-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem 1.4rem; align-items: flex-start; margin: .8rem 0; }
#ct-root .ct-sortrow { display: flex; gap: .4rem; align-items: center; margin: .2rem 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
#ct-root .ct-sortrow > span { min-width: 4.2em; font-size: .9rem; }
#ct-root select, #ct-root input[type=number] { padding: .25rem .4rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: inherit; font: inherit; font-size: .9rem; }
#ct-root input[type=number] { width: 5em; }
#ct-root button { padding: .25rem .6rem; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: inherit; font-size: .88rem; cursor: pointer; }
#ct-root button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
#ct-root .ct-dir { min-width: 9.5em; text-align: left; }
#ct-root .ct-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .35rem; }
#ct-root .ct-line { display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: .9rem; }
#ct-root .ct-pager { display: flex; gap: .6rem; align-items: center; margin: .6rem 0; font-size: .9rem; }
#ct-count { font-weight: 600; margin-top: .6rem; scroll-margin-top: 80px; }
#ct-status { opacity: .7; font-size: .9rem; }
#ct-root .ct-warn { border-left: 4px solid #d97706; padding: .4rem .8rem; background: rgba(217,119,6,.08); }
#ct-root .ct-credit { font-size: .85rem; opacity: .8; }
#ct-list { display: grid; gap: .8rem; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
#ct-list[data-cols="2"] { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
#ct-list[data-cols="3"] { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
@media (max-width: 760px) { #ct-list[data-cols] { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
#ct-root .ct-card { border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ddd); border-radius: 10px; padding: .6rem .8rem; min-height: 190px; min-width: 0; }
#ct-root .ct-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: .8rem; align-items: flex-start; }
#ct-root .ct-title { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; }
#ct-root .ct-move { font-style: italic; font-size: .9rem; }
#ct-root .ct-comp { font-size: .85rem; opacity: .75; }
#ct-root .ct-btns { display: flex; gap: .5rem; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; font-size: .85rem; }
#ct-root .ct-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem .4rem; font-size: .76rem; }
#ct-root .ct-meta span { padding: .05rem .45rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bs-tertiary-bg, #f1f3f5); }
#ct-root .ct-score { min-height: 90px; margin-bottom: .35rem; }

#ct-picker .tl-results, #ct-picker .tl-sort, #ct-picker .tl-count { display: none; }
</style>
<div id="ct-root">
  <p class="ct-warn"><strong>Reference only: partly unreliable.</strong> The original set of 9,824 themes. The 2,067 that the
  <a href="https://www.audiolabs-erlangen.de/resources/MIR/MTD">Musical Theme Dataset</a> has are its corrected versions (tagged
  "corrected (MTD)", played at their recording's tempo); they are also on <a href="classical-themes.html">Classical Themes</a>.
  The rest are midi2abc conversions of the <em>Electronic Dictionary of Musical Themes</em> MIDI, with beams and repeated
  accidentals tidied but the notes as they were: many are barred from the first note instead of the pickup, have lost or
  broken triplets, or sit an octave off. Themes that sit very high have been moved down an octave by rule (tagged "octave lowered
  (guessed)"; the rule was right 98.7% of the time on the themes MTD also has), which catches a bit under half of the octave errors. Those play at 96 unless you type a tempo in.</p>
  <div id="ct-picker"></div>
  <div class="ct-controls">
    <div class="ct-group" id="ct-sorts"></div>
    <div class="ct-group">
      <div class="ct-line"><label for="ct-per">Show</label>
        <select id="ct-per"><option value="1">1</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="10">10</option><option value="25">25</option>
          <option value="50">50</option><option value="100">100</option><option value="250">250</option><option value="n">Other…</option><option value="all">All</option></select>
        <input type="number" id="ct-pernum" min="1" max="10000" aria-label="Themes a page"> at a time</div>
      <div class="ct-line"><label for="ct-cols">Columns</label>
        <select id="ct-cols"><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option></select></div>
      <div class="ct-line"><label for="ct-tempo">Play at</label><input type="number" id="ct-tempo" min="10" max="600" placeholder="96"> per quarter note</div>
      <div class="ct-line"><label><input type="checkbox" id="ct-yt"> Only themes with a recording link</label>
        <button type="button" id="ct-reshuffle" title="New order for the Random sort">Reshuffle</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="ct-status" aria-live="polite"></div>
  <div id="ct-count"></div>
  <div class="ct-pager"><button type="button" id="ct-prev">← Previous</button><span class="ct-pagelab"></span><button type="button" id="ct-next">Next →</button></div>
  <div id="ct-list"></div>
  <div class="ct-pager"><button type="button" id="ct-prev2">← Previous</button><span class="ct-pagelab"></span><button type="button" id="ct-next2">Next →</button></div>
</div>
```
